description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Rakdos triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top card of the opponent's library with the ability to cast it until your next end step.
Repeat.
